experimental_interpretation: Four forward-season folds: fit earlier seasons, evaluate 2022-23 through reviewed 2025-26. One row per night per horizon. Fixed 0.5 threshold, fitting-only imputation/scaling and missingness; no tuned cutoff or post-hoc calibration. Wilson 95% recall intervals assume independent nights; small seasons and serial weather dependence limit precision. All metrics are retrospective EXPERIMENTAL RESEARCH, not an unseen final test. Final local candidates refit all 280/277 nights; their out-of-fold metrics describe the procedure, not independent validation of that refit.
experimental_weaknesses: Logistic above-freezing recall: 10/18 (0h), 12/18 (1h), 5/18 (3h), 3/16 (6h). Clear/humid subsets have false-positive rates 37.5%, 50%, 43.75%, 50% with only 16 other-treatment nights per horizon. At 1h, seasonal recall ranges 45.5% to 92.6%. Forests trade substantially lower recall for fewer false alarms. No model was selected for promotion.
